text:
mia: Heads up — we just got multiple reports that on-call pages didn't fire for ~20m, customers saw delayed alerts and escalations. I see retries from notify-proxy but no page activity. :rotating_light:
jordan: Confirmed — our alert router shows outbound webhook successes but Pagerflow returns 502s for the /pages endpoint starting 10:32 UTC. No page created.
chun: I'm the oncall right now, didn't get any page or SMS. I only saw the Slack channel messages.
sam: Which integration was used? pagerflow or direct notify?
jordan: Looks like notify-proxy -> pagerflow -> incident-bot. The proxy forwarded the payload but pagerflow responded 502 and we didn't trigger fallback.
incident-bot: automated: Delivered webhook to Pagerflow at 2024-09-18T10:32:11Z, response 502. Retries attempted: 3. No page created.
ops-runbot: metric alert: pagerflow.webhook.5xx.rate spiked from 0.1 to 12.4 for 3m at 10:32 UTC.
mia: I'm triggering manual fallback now — will send SMS and escalate to backup oncall.
tilly-support: We've got 5 inbound support tickets referencing "missed page / late alert" — one customer (acct: acme-inc) says their production customers saw inference timeouts.
sam: Command to manually force page (allowed for ops):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal/pager/manual_page" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"team":"oncall","severity":"P0","message":"Manual page: pagerflow failed"}'
```
mia: Ran manual page and SMS to backup oncall at 10:37 UTC, acknowledged by chun.
chun: acked. standing by and triaging. I can take live logs if needed.
jordan: dug into logs — Pagerflow is returning 502 when signature header length > 1024 bytes. Looks like header gets truncated by our proxy's header-sanitizer. Payload intact but X-Sig header is cut off, so Pagerflow rejects.
sam: That header truncation is new — we rolled header-sanitizer v2 last week. Can we roll it back to disable trimming?
mia: Rolling back header-sanitizer to v1 in staging now, will schedule prod rollback if staging reproduces.
ops-runbot: deploybot: rollback job started for header-sanitizer v1 -> target=prod, job=rollback-4821
incident-bot: note: triage labeled impact: multi-tenant paging failures, estimated customers affected: 4 orgs, 6 endpoints.
tilly-support: Customer impact: a few inference calls timed out; support escalated to engineering for investigation. No revenue-impacting outages reported yet.
jordan: Temporary mitigation checklist: 1) enable proxy passthrough to preserve headers 2) enable pagerflow signature len-tolerant mode 3) add validation alert for header length > 900 bytes.
chun: I'm running local replay of the failing webhook and confirm header is trimmed to 512 bytes. After passthrough we get full 2048 bytes and Pagerflow accepts.
mia: Good. I'll keep rollback in flight. After rollback we'll re-run the failed webhooks via replayer and confirm pages go through.
sam: Also adding short-term alert: if pagerflow.webhook.5xx.rate > 5 for >1m, automatically trigger failover to manual-sms route.
jordan: Created incident ticket INC-2024-857 and assigned to eng-oncall + infra.
mia: Thanks everyone — manual mitigation in place, oncall acked. Postmortem actions: add header-length unit tests to proxy, add fallback to incident-bot if pagerflow 5xx persists, and add a runbook step to force manual pages.
chun: Will stay on the thread until rollback verified.
incident-bot: resolution update: header-sanitizer rollback to v1 completed at 10:52 UTC; replayed 9 webhooks, 9 pages delivered. Closing active mitigation.
mia: Post-incident notes: assign to eng-infra for root cause + code fix, and to devex to update runbook. I'll open the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
